purpose: Local acceptance expectations, not an official Sheets API payload or a cloud receipt
checks: Use the official response row_indices and col_indices to locate cells; do not infer their coordinates from array offsets.
Read values and formulas separately, preserve raw responses, and reject incomplete/truncated acceptance reads.

Restore only B3. Do not replay the full matrix for recovery.
If an API write outcome is uncertain, read before any retry.
